subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supplier Diversity
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Supplier Diversity.

hook.text: A Fortune 500 firm spent $2 billion with minority-owned businesses last year. It wasn't charity—it was strategy.

buildup.text: Supplier diversity programs intentionally include businesses owned by minorities, women, and veterans.

discovery.text: Diverse suppliers bring innovation, competitive pricing, and access to new markets and communities.

twist.text: Critics call it tokenism. But data shows diverse supply bases are more resilient and more innovative.

climax.text: Companies with strong diversity programs report higher supply chain agility and better community relations.

punchline.text: Diverse suppliers make supply chains stronger, not weaker.

quiz.question: What business benefit does supplier diversity provide?
options: Greater innovation, resilience, and market access
